name: KOZO KEIKAKU ENGINEERING HOLDINGS Inc.
summary: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited supplies turnkey robotics and automation solutions to customers in India, Asia and elsewhere. It builds automated assembly lines for four-wheelers and three-wheelers, semi-automated lines for two-wheelers, simulation systems and automated car parking. It also makes conveyors, inspection stations, pick-and-place systems, robotic welding cells and welding fixtures.
